primitives.name: Conditional Relation Generation
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Conditional relation generation via diffusion**: extends DDPM with an embedding step q_φ(x_0|v) = N(x_0; Emb_φ(v), σ_0 I) mapping discrete relation words into R^d (d = CLIP dim, 512), and a trainable rounding step p_θ(v|x_0) = ∏i p_θ(v_i|x_0^(i)) (softmax over V).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'x_0': 'initial latent variable (image-level relation vector, dimension d=512)', 'v': 'discrete predicate word (relation label, vocabulary size |V|=4858)', 'Emb_φ(v)': 'CLIP embedding of v (dimension d=512)', 'f_θ(x_1, 1)': 'learned reverse process output at time t=1', 'ε': 'noise sample from standard normal distribution', 'p_θ(v|x_0)': 'probability of generating v given x_0'}

primitives.breakdown_regime: When |v| exceeds training vocabulary or when CLIP embeddings fail to disambiguate semantically similar predicates.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in extending DDPM to generate visual relations via a two-stage process: first, embedding discrete predicates into continuous CLIP space; second, rounding back to discrete labels via softmax. This allows open-vocabulary HOI without fixed taxonomy constraints. The diffusion objective includes a variational lower bound (VLB) that incorporates both noise prediction and embedding fidelity. Bipartite matching aligns generated relations with subject-object pairs using cosine similarity and Hungarian algorithm. The matching supervision trades off detection recall for diversity, which is critical for GSE’s rich event semantics. The method's strength is its ability to generalize beyond training categories while maintaining alignment with ground truth spatial structures. Failure modes include misalignment due to ambiguous embeddings or poor matching when L exceeds valid pairs.
